inspection: Actual returned PNG opened through view_image and read at original 1536x1024. Its unchanged PNG bytes are copied into this run; MIME declaration for display corrected from application/octet-stream to image/png without changing image bytes.

rule.pass_requires: every required scene gate visible and passed in this same saved image

gates.pass_condition: Physical CRT television and VHS deck are visible together, with recording artifacts bounded to the screen.
gates.evidence: A large curved CRT with a thick enclosing bezel sits directly over a VHS deck. The screen has multicolored video noise and a bright horizontal lower-edge tracking tear; those artifacts stop at the display boundary.

gates.pass_condition: The embedded screen visibly contains a person seated in a recognizable mustard chair.
gates.evidence: The CRT shows a pale-faced, dark-clothed person seated upright in a mustard upholstered chair, with the torso and both chair arms visible. This is a visibly depicted occupant, without claiming identity or familiarity.

gates.pass_condition: The matching physical chair is visibly empty; its seat and backrest are readable.
gates.evidence: The matching physical mustard chair at image right is clearly empty. Its seat, backrest and both armrests are visible, with no figure occupying them.

gates.pass_condition: Recorded occupied chair and present empty chair can be compared in one image, with a matching distinctive seam or equivalent clear chair design.
gates.evidence: The screen chair and real chair share mustard upholstery, armchair silhouette and a diagonal dark repaired seam on the back. Occupied display state and empty physical state are visible together in the same PNG.

gates.pass_condition: The foreground woman visibly directs attention between recording and real chair; actual gaze/head direction is assessed conservatively.
gates.evidence: The foreground woman turns her face and eyes toward image right where the real empty chair stands, while holding a remote. This supports checking behavior in relation to the displayed occupant; a still cannot prove the temporal beginning of the turn.

gates.pass_condition: Foreground face/hair visibly carry the supplied portrait guidance at the rendered scale; no claim of identity.
gates.evidence: The foreground woman visibly retains a short dark bob, fine separated bangs, large dark eyes and related facial proportions from the supplied portrait. The three-quarter view and low light permit appearance guidance assessment, not identity certification.

gates.pass_condition: The room, woman and mediated occupant imply a disturbing private-recording discovery beyond a generic retro filter.
gates.evidence: The dim private room, paused noisy CRT image of a seated person, matching empty actual chair, and woman checking that chair form a readable mediated intrusion. The disturbing comparison is present independently of a generic retro texture.

limits: A single still does not establish an actual VHS recording, its date, playback motion, sound or history.
The image shows a displayed occupant and present vacancy; it does not establish paranormal causation or who the recorded person is.
Reference use is visible appearance guidance, not identity verification.
No rendered comparison baseline exists, so no candidate-caused artistic improvement is established.
A038 and A049 are unqualified materials and were not adopted as native whole-source contracts; this scene pass is not a claim that those complete source cases passed.
